info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Hotel Rooms Pricings-v1-spec
info.description: The Hotel Room Pricing Retrieval API provides access to the current pricing information for hotel rooms. This endpoint allows developers to query and receive a comprehensive list of available room prices, which can be utilized in applications for booking engines or travel platforms. It's designed for businesses in the hospitality and travel sectors that need to present accurate and up-to-date pricing to their users. Typical consumers of this API include travel agencies, hotel management systems, and mobile app developers focused on accommodations.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the pricing details for the available rooms. You can use this information to understand the cost associated with each room type, including any applicable discounts or special offers.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving pricing information for rooms. This body should include the necessary parameters to specify the desired room type and date range for the pricing query.

200.description: The pricing information for rooms has been successfully retrieved.
